list.title: Skills
list.emptyBody: A skill is a block of review rules an agent receives in its prompt. Create one or import a SKILL.md.
list.selectBody: Pick a skill on the left to see how an agent receives it.

card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
card.toggle: Enable or disable this skill for every agent

form.name: Name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag tests that skip boundary values.
form.descriptionHint: Say what the reviewer must do, e.g. “Flag …”. This is the skill's interface.
form.enabledHint: Whether this block is added to agents' prompts.

editor.hint: The only text sent to the model. Everything else is metadata.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a markdown block of rules added to an agent's prompt.

import.title: Import skill
import.sourceSubtitle: From a .md file, a .zip with a SKILL.md, or a public https URL.
import.previewSubtitle: Review before saving — nothing is stored until you save.
import.trustNotice: An imported skill becomes instructions in your agent's prompt. Read it before saving.
import.ignoredHint: Only SKILL.md is imported. These files are never executed, stored or sent to a model.
import.renderedBody: As the agent will receive it

config.heading: Configuration
config.snapshotHint: Saving snapshots the body as v{version}.
config.dangerBody: Removes it from all agents. This can't be undone.

preview.hint: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

versions.heading: Version history
versions.hint: Every body change is snapshotted, so you can compare and roll back.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? The current body is kept in history and v{version}'s body becomes a new version.
versions.restored: Restored v{version} as a new version.

delete.title: Delete skill
delete.linked: {count, plural, one {It is linked to # agent and will be removed from it.} other {It is linked to # agents and will be removed from them.}}
